Portronics Muffs M4 Headphone – Wireless ANC Headphones with 40H Playback

Experience immersive sound and distraction-free listening with the Portronics Muffs M4 Headphone. Designed for music lovers, gamers, professionals, and travelers, this powerful wireless headset combines advanced Active Noise Cancellation, Bluetooth 5.3 connectivity, and long-lasting battery performance. The sleek black finish, ergonomic ear cushions, and lightweight build make the Muffs M4 ideal for extended daily use, whether you are attending calls, enjoying playlists, or watching movies.

With up to 40 hours of playback time, you can stay unplugged for days. The fast and convenient Type-C charging port ensures quick power-ups, while the in-built microphone delivers crystal-clear voice capture for meetings and online classes. Built for modern lifestyles, the Portronics headset provides stable pairing, deep bass, and balanced audio across devices.

Key Features of Portronics Muffs M4

  • Active Noise Cancellation (ANC): Blocks unwanted background noise for focused listening.
  • Bluetooth Version 5.3: Faster pairing, low latency, and stable wireless connection.
  • 40 Hours Playback: Enjoy uninterrupted music, calls, and entertainment.
  • Type-C Charging: Quick, reliable, and universal charging support.
  • In-Built Microphone: Clear communication for calls, meetings, and gaming chat.
  • Comfort Fit Design: Soft earcups and adjustable headband for long usage.
  • Deep Bass & HD Sound: Rich audio clarity with balanced highs and Mids.
  • Universal Compatibility: Works with smartphones, laptops, tablets, and smart TVs.

Powerful Wireless Performance

The is powered by the latest Bluetooth 5.3 technology, offering improved range, quick device switching, and energy efficiency. Whether commuting, working from home, or traveling, you get seamless audio without drops or lag. The wireless freedom combined with ANC helps you stay productive in noisy environments.

All-Day Battery Life

Long battery life is essential for modern users. With up to 40 hours of playtime on a single charge, the Muffs M4 keeps your music going through workdays and weekend trips. When you finally need power, the Type-C port gets you back quickly so you never miss a beat.

Designed for Comfort & Style

Crafted in an elegant black color, these over-ear headphones deliver both aesthetics and durability. The cushioned ear pads reduce pressure, making the Portronics Muffs M4 comfortable during binge watching, gaming sessions, and long conference calls.

Perfect for Calls & Online Meetings

The integrated microphone ensures your voice is heard clearly. From office meetings to virtual classes, the maintains consistent audio quality, making communication smooth and professional. If you are searching for wireless ANC headphones with long battery life, premium sound, and  reliable performance, the Portronics Muffs M4 is an excellent everyday companion.
